def norm(t): return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", t.lower()).strip()

train = [json.loads(l)["content"] for l in open("data/raw/indonesian_news_train_800.jsonl", encoding="utf-8") if l.strip()]
proc_test = [json.loads(l)["content"] for l in open("data/processed/test.jsonl", encoding="utf-8") if l.strip()]
proc_train = [json.loads(l)["content"] for l in open("data/processed/train.jsonl", encoding="utf-8") if l.strip()]
proc_val = [json.loads(l)["content"] for l in open("data/processed/val.jsonl", encoding="utf-8") if l.strip()]

print("raw test 200:", len(raw_test), "| unik normalized:", len({norm(t) for t in raw_test}))
c = Counter(norm(t) for t in raw_test)
print("dup count (konten >1x):", sum(1 for v in c.values() if v > 1))

tr_n = {norm(t) for t in train}
proc_test_n = {norm(t) for t in proc_test}
print("raw-test unik n raw-train overlap:", len({norm(t) for t in raw_test} & tr_n))
print("proc test:", len(proc_test), "| unik:", len(proc_test_n))
print("proc train:", len(proc_train), "val:", len(proc_val))
print("overlap proc train-test:", len({norm(t) for t in proc_train} & proc_test_n))
print("overlap proc val-test:", len({norm(t) for t in proc_val} & proc_test_n))
print("proc-test == raw-test-unik:", proc_test_n == {norm(t) for t in raw_test})
